kind: other
depth: deep
reason: deep-count-for-each
-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name                      = "q"
  message_retention_seconds = 60
}

module "alarms" {
  source = "./modules/alarms"
  queue  = aws_sqs_queue.this
}
-- base/modules/alarms/main.tf --
resource "aws_sns_topic" "this" {
  for_each = { for k, v in var.queue : k => v if k == "name" }
  name     = each.value
}

variable "queue" {
  type = any
}
-- head/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name                      = "q"
  message_retention_seconds = 120
}

module "alarms" {
  source = "./modules/alarms"
  queue  = aws_sqs_queue.this
}
-- head/modules/alarms/main.tf --
resource "aws_sns_topic" "this" {
  for_each = { for k, v in var.queue : k => v if k == "name" }
  name     = each.value
}

variable "queue" {
  type = any
}
